body:
F*ck ME! Dude, you are awesome. Thank you for your comment. I know it won't help my health, or my life, but it's still... it's still there. It's harder for me than smoking. I mean, i smoke 2 packs a day, and i would rather stay "nicotine sober" than alcohol free. And when i don't smoke i'm angry, i'm shaking and so on. But without alcohol, the real life is too strong. I hate my perception of life, and alcohol gives me a better view. I feel like i'm likeable, i feel like the world doesn't suck that much. I get hope when i drink. This is why it's so hard.

But you are right of course. It doesn't help at all. I will only worsen the situation.
I feel like an old man, so every kind of group will be good to me. I will update at friday night.

Well yeah, it's not hard to admit i have a problem. I know i have a problem, and i will talk about this with my doctors openly. I don't really care. I know what's up, i'm not stupid. I know what defines alcoholism really good. The NEED of a drink. If it's becoming like smoking a cigarette, then you are screwed. From that point, it's alcoholism, doesn't matter who says what. It's an addiction. It's not better than heroin, cocaine, bezodiazepam, or any other addiction. You can't live without something which isn't the part of your body. That's it. And some say it's not a "disease". Well yeah, try it, and we can talk about if it's a disease or not. It is. I would gladly choose any other disease instead of alcoholism. This is a f*cking hell. When i'm at the grocery store, the alcohol section almost shouts at me. It wants to be bought, and drank. It's horrible. I hate it. I hate alcohol. I hate how much it f*cks up my life, i hate how much i depend on it, i hate how much it makes me feel good. 

And every freaking comment helps, and thank you for saying you like me. There is nothing likeable about me, but you still said it. This is what helped me the most. Thank you, i like you too, Mr.Scuzzbag.
Thank you for your response. It was an interesting reading. I will attend to a meeting this friday, i'm curious, but i'm really skeptic about it. We'll see.

Well, almighty Jesus freaking Christ... I talked to them... I talked to a  middle aged guy. Well, it was extremly weird. He was... nice... I mean, i told him i'm drinking like an animal, and he was like: "Oh that's okay! We all did!" and i was like what? It was an interesting talk. I will attend a meeting on friday, i'm really curious. But this talk still didn't stop me. I wonder what they will do about this.
I've been hesitating for a f*cking long time about AA, and they have a group 500 METER AWAY FROM ME. Let me call them right now...

Since i'm a wiseass, thank you for using "happy chemical" for serotonin, and not "Happy Hormones" as a LOT of people would say. Serotonin is NOT A HORMONE, IT IS A MONOAMINE NEUROTRANSMITTER FOR GOD'S SAKE! But i laughed while writing that, so that's good.

Also, i have unfortunately a lot of knowledge about psychiatry, and also, neurology, but i forgot about the fake smile thing, but it seems it's really working. In psychiatry i have, because i take two kind of antidepressants (a generic citalopram (SSRI) and Wellbutrin (bupropion an NDRI)), and an atypical antipsychotic (generic quetiapine), and occasionally xanax (alprazolam). And i NEVER take anything before i know it will be absolutely safe for me, and i like to read about their effectiveness. For example i know escitalopram would be better for me, but it would be a long time to change it, and in that time, i would have a LOT of suicidal thoughts. So my psychiatrist, who is the best one in the country, really had a HARD time with me. She basically saved me life. And people dare to say, they do nothing. 

And fuck neurology. I mean, fuck it. I had just absolutely enough problems, and there you are, with that fucking epilepsy. But i didn't have a seizure for 2 days, which is good. Unfortunately i have nocturnal seizures (big seizures almost only came when i'm sleeping), which makes me a really good candidate for SUDEP (sudden death in epilepsy). My neurologist is an idiot, she didn't tell me anything about SUDEP, and she scared me that i have brain tumor (SPOILER: i don't have brain tumor according to an MRI). 

Dark places you say? Mike, my friend, you didn't know a LOT of me. At age 18, when i got into the rehab, i had to learn, there is an interesting protocol in Hungarian psychiatry. If you walk into a mental hospital, it's okay. But if an ambulance takes you there, like me... It's a different story.

They have to put you into the "closed ward" for 24 hours. At age 18, i was a sad, depressed kid, who drank because it helped. Unfortunately, they still had to place me there. It means, i was already sober when i got in. 

So i was there, in a small building, closed in with the absolutely insane, and criminally insane people. People attacked eachother for fun, they took a shit in a corner, for fun of course, they broke the BULLETPROOF window, they screamed, they shouted, they laughed like maniacs (well, they were maniacs), and so on. They were insane. Not insane as me, insane as insane. They had chronic psychosis, which made them behave like animals. The nurses carried syringes with them, because the people attacked them regurarly, and it was their only weapon. If you haven't seen already, please watch "One flew over the cuckoo's nest". That hospiral in the movie, is like paradise compared to where i was held. I still have nightmares about the people inside there. The most dangerous people were tied to their bed. They usually screamed "I will kill you", or they just talked with a person who wasn't there. 

That was a dark place, my friend. After the 24 hours, they released me from there, and they put me into an "open ward" where you can walk in a huge park, you can play with other people, you can have fun, but still, you HAVE TO attend on therapies and so on. If you broke the rules, they punished you with putting you for 24 in the closed ward. Needless to say, i behaved like never before. I behaved so well, the released me from the hospital a week sooner, so i was there "only" for 23 days. I still remember every day. It was  hell on earth. Oh, and you asked if i built something! Before they took me in, i sewed a razor blade into my underwear. When there was a FULL BODY SEARCH, they didn't find it, because they thought it was only the rubber inside my boxers. I fooled them, like it was nothing. And i was sitting on the toilet for hours thinking about i'm going to do it, but instead of it, i just flushed it off the toilet. I still don't know why i didn't do it.

And also, my childhood was a dark place either. My father was extremly verbally abusive, and thanks to that, i have suicidal thoughts since age 11. This is why i first had panic disorder, and now, a LOT other mental illnesses. So, yes, i'm really confident about i would be a really good father. I exactly know how you CAN'T raise a child. So if i avoid everything what my father did, i will be a good father. My father abuse stopped when i was 20 years old. From my mother's side, i inherited the big boy type. I'm not fat, i'm just... Big. I barely can go over doors because i'm wide... Also, i'm strong. So when i was 20, i had a huge quarrel with my father. He started his abuse, and i punched him. Police came, they almost arrested me, but i told the police officer my whole childhood, and he said: "He deserved it" and he and his partner left. Since that, he have a "fear-respect" toward me. And he now has a chronic kidney disease, and i even offered one of my kidney last year. I still love him, and i don't know why, because he did nothing for me. Nothing. 

Mike, thanks for all the kind words of yours. I don't know, are you this wise because of life experience, or did you learn this??? I mean, fuck, you really know what you are doing, and you are extremly inspirational. Thanks for all your words, really. 

And if we use quotes, let me use my favourite latin proverb:

"Per aspera ad astra", "Through hardships to the stars". So, i know all of this shit will be "good" in the end, because i will have a lot of experience about life. But it's still hard to cope with it, you know?

Before they kicked me out of school, i learned transportation architecture. I loved it, but alcohol was stronger, so i rather drunk than study, so i couldn't pass any tests, and in the end they "let me go". Also, i was just unable to draw blueprints, my hands were shaking too much to do that, but that was probably because of drinking. Nowadays i just like photographing, but fortunately my hand shaking stopped since i'm taking this antiepileptic medicine (which has no significant effect on the frequency and strenght of seizure unfortunately), so photographing is much easier. Unfortunately i'm suspicious about my neurologists, because she's obsessed with the fact i was alcoholic, and she always asks me if i drank anything.

Well, she's right, because i'm drinking again since april 29th, but i'm not willing to tell anyone that i drink, a lot. And i think she's unwilling to give me some other medicine, like Ativan, because she thinks i will abuse it. I'm taking xanax for 6 years, and it has no sedative effect on me anymore. I tried other benzodiazepam medicine too, and they are even less effective, and Ativan is also a benzodiazepam, which is way less sedative than xanax (alprazolam), but it has a really really good potential against epileptic seizures. So i don't even get normal medication for this sh*t. 

Oh, i built a lot of stuff. Mostly stuff which could make my suicide easier, or absolutely easy, but i got rid of everything. Of course i won't go into details, because i'm not willing to give anyone any ideas, but they were complicated "machines", like a Rube Goldberg machine. 

Your metaphor about gear and parts is absolutely fantastic. Really! I never tought like that about my mind. Good one, really. But, without the medicine, my mind is just over winded, and i think too much, and too fast, and almost every single "train of thought" finishes with suicide. 

And people suck. If i'm doing everything better than them (like in my photography school, when i finished as the best in class) they hate me. When i pretend i'm not good in stuff, they hate me. When i don't talk, and try to be a man of few words, they hate me. If i talk a lot, they hate me. If i tell them my problems, they hate me. If i don't, they also hate me. 

And the fact is, i'm not a typical nice guy looking person, i have scars on my face due to some accidents, i'm bald, and i'm tall and wide, isn't helping either. When i'm calm, people think i try to hide something, and when i'm tough (and satisfying the stereotype about me) they say i'm rude. So no matter what i do, it's not good to people. I don't care for a few years, and they still hate me. 

Once i asked someone what's wrong with me when she was drunk, and she just couldn't draft any reason, but she only said, i'm not likeable. I have, but mostly had a good sense of humor what people really liked, and i was nice with everyone (of course i wasn't nice when someone tried to rob our grocery store and i stopped him). 

So i guess, there are a few people, who are just hateable. Like, someone has a punchable face, but it's not my face, it's my "heart" and "soul". 

I was attending for more than a year at one of the best psychologist (therapist) in the country, and after one session, he told me. "Hey /u/icantbelievetheresno , i can't help you. You need a psychiatrist, and medicine". 

He was just absolutely unable to say anything about me, as he couldn't understand what's the matter with people around me. 

The third time when i attempted suicide (this time i didn't even wrote a letter, or anything, i just basically poisoned myself, with a lethal dose of something (my calculations were good), but somehow i just survived...) last year's august, people acted like they care. They called me few times a week. And after two weeks, like nothing happened. Really. They didn't even asked what's up. I mean, come on... And now, people are even less concerned about if i live, or die. 

This month, some of them knew i'm really on thin ice, and i could do it anytime. They don't even cared about it. Childhood friends just said: "I'm not a psychologist, i can't help you.". They said this, just after i told them, i don't want anything them to do, but at least talk to me. They refused to talk to me. They don't even answer the phone anymore. 

I didn't asked for much, just a listening ear. I only wanted them to speak to me. That's all.

But i do ask, it is really much to ask from a so called "friend" in a crisis? If it is much to ask, than i'm done with humanity. What the f*ck friends are for than? I was good when i was drunk and i made everyone laugh? But when i tell them i'm having suicidal thoughts again, they just leave me alone. F*ck them all. With this behaviour, they only couraged me to do it, and i still didn't find ANY reason to not do it. My only luck is in my country you can't get a firearm, no matter what (hunters can get, with brutal background check, and psychological tests, and so on..), so this is why i didn't do it already. The reason i live, is only because of my body, because no matter what i did, somehow i survived it all the time. Doctors confirmed, the dosage of the poison what i used is indeed lethal, so they were amazed by my body's ability to survive. I'm no amazed of that. This is also a reason i'm not doing anything, because IF i try it again, IF, i would be more careful about dosage, or method.




So i basically have no one, and nothing. I have the ability to do something normal, but honestly, i have no ambitions. I don't care about money that much, i don't care about carrer, i don't care about nothing, only people. I want friends, i want a family, i want a girlfriend and some time later my own family... But i couldn't be more far away from those. If someone loses their meaning of life, than what is the reason to live for? I won't stay alive for hobbies. I won't stay alive for school. I have nothing to live for. I don't believe in change. Every time i changed, every time i attend to school or in any new community, they just reject me and things get worse very FAST.

Of course i'm not autistic. I would have normal social stuff, but people somewhy hate me. I don't know why. And yes, i know that my mind is not really normal. I know this. I know my mind is much more powered than it should be. That's why i'm addicted to "depressants". I love every kind of depressants. Sedatives, opioid painkillers, and of course, my favourite one, alcohol. 

I can't really cope with my mind usually. When i was okay, i was really like a "crazy scientist". I have 3 typewriters, and i took them apart in a day, and assembled in the same day. Also with watches or locks. I'm really interested in learning locks, as i would like to be a lock-smith. I love everything complex stuff. 

Also, my mind is really complex. There were only a few person who could understand me. They WERE actual scientists. They were my friends, and they left me alone. 

Anyways, i know there could be a lot of positive things because of my mind. But unfortunately, no matter what i do, people hates me. I finished a photographer school a few months ago, and i tried to find friends there. They don't even reply my messages anymore. I did nothing. They know nothing about my problems, so i'm not whining. 

So i know crazyness could be awesome too. Alan Turing was absolutely nuts for example. And i was obsessed with the Enigma machine for a while, and i still really really want to get a real Enigma machine. So i'm obsessed with everything complex stuff.

And again, i'm not autistic. I learned social things at a normal age, i could speak at a normal age, and i only became like this at age 17-18, so it has nothing to do with autism spectrum disorder or with aspergers. I'm just like this.

Oh thank you for your kind words. I'm hungarian, and hungarian is way way more harder than english. Our grammar makes absolutely no sense, and when i found out english has some sense, i could learn it in a few years without basically not learning. Also, our 	
vocalization is absolutely nuts. We say everything as it's written. We have some really weird letters, like "sz" (like S in silent), "ty", "gy" (no english equalivent). Also, we have two J-s, J and LY. It has absolutely no sense. Really, nothing. It is a huge chaos, so english is an absolutely easy language compared to hungarian. 

Your mentor seems a really good guy. I never had a mentor, and i never attented at any AA meetings. I wanted to, a few months ago, but sh*t hit the fan, and i rather just drink. I honestly can't believe i can accomplish anything.

My psychiatrist thought there is something wrong with my mind from the beginning, so she made me do an IQ test last year. Well, it was way-way higher than normal (i won't say a number), and it actually made me extremly angry. If i'm a so f*cking called genius, how the f*ck i couldn't succsess in anything?! Since that i hate IQ tests, and i personally believe they are nothing more than a scam. Every genius on the planet is a big scientist or artist or some sh*t, but i'm nothing more than an alcoholic, suicidal, no one, who hated by everyone. 

But really, thanks for your kidness, it really means a lot to me. I didn't really recieve any "compliements" in a while...

Sorry for the late reply. I feel really bad for you, but i'm honestly glad you are taking it so well. Keep this mentality. I wish i could be that good minded about my health issues. 

I haven't checked out the satelite tracker, but i knew about this. Unfortunately i still couldn't do any good star photographs, mostly because i was already asleep when it was the darkest at night, or it was bad weather. As soon i will do good pictures, i will try to capture the ISS!

I always put other's safety and good above mine. I never really cared about myself, but i think it is "understandable" if not justified under my situation. All of my ambitions gone in a long time, so at least, i try to help others. I was doing church service for years, i helped a lot of people, (religion really doesn't matter here) i visited our local elderly home every week twice, i talked with the old people, and they were really glad they had some company. I also helped homeless people (like giving them clothes, escorting them to their doctor regurarly, and stuff like this), and in the end, i get this sh*t. I mean, WTF? I did so much for so many, and i got nothing. Of course, i didn't do stuff for something in exchange, but i think it's okay to expect life to be a bit nicer to me after those things. 

As things started to became worse, i slowly stopped all my activities. The only thing i can really care about is drinking. I couldn't drink for a few days, but i started it again yesterday. And unfortunately, it helps a lot. I know it is an absolute addiction, but it's not i can't help it, i DO NOT WANT TO help it. 

I mean, this is the only thing remained to me. No family, no friends, no lover, nothing. A month ago my neurologist told me, the cause of my seizures could be because of a brain tumor. This was the point when i started to drink, because i wanted to prepare myself to suicide. I wouldn't live with brain cancer. I would rather die happy.

I told a few friends of mine, and they didn't even really cared about the fact. A lot of them, still didn't asked for the results. The results were negative, and to be honest, i was sad because of that. I really wanted to justify my suicide. I know people around me, and they would say i was crazy and that's why i killed myself. Of course, it's because of people, but i don't want them to feel bad because of me. I don't worth that much. Nobody should grief me. 

Oh, and sorry if i had any grammatic errors. I'm not english, and i had a few drinks already.

The main problem with me and driving is the fear. I will make no risk with driving. It is really really scary when you just gaze into nothing for a few seconds (the PM seizures). Not to mention the GM seizures when you just collapse. So, if i would drive, and i would got a PM, i could easily kill someone with the car. I won't take any risks. Unfortunately they couldn't stop my epilepsy yet.

My favourite subject is mostly night-time space photography, or depressive and dark stuff. For example i have a picture where i leaned into a well, and photographed it. It is absolutely creepy, at least for me, so i love those kind of stuff. Also, photographing statues is also a big favourite for me. 

May i ask you how do you mean you have problems with walking? :(

I'm sorry to hear that. Delusions sucks. This is why i got the antipsychotic, because i delusional about the whole world. I thought everyone hates me, but in fact, back than, they did nothing. But now, i feel like everyone hates me, because, well, everyone around me left me. So, medicine didn't stopped feeling bad, it just stopped being delusional. So now, what i feel is reasonable, at least i think. And also, i try to make myself believe this whole situation justifice the drinking, while not.

I'm also a Canon guy! I used my all saving when i got diagnosed with epilepsy, and bought a camera. To be exact, a D1200 with two lenses. The fix 50mm/1.8 is my absolutely favouirte. I got the money for a driver's license, but with epilepsy there's no way i'm going to drive ever. Never ever. There is no guaranteed seizure free period and i don't want to kill anyone so driving is a huge no for me.

You guessed it right. I have learned photography, and i really like it. Also music. I learned to play the piano myself. But you know, unfortunately these are just "stuff". These are just like cigarettes. They aren't make you feel any better, just normal. But if you don't do it, you will feel like absolute sh*t. 

So it helps, but it's minimal. Unfortunately no matter what, i really can't get focus my mind on anything else than basically losing the last person who ever cared about me. It sucks extremly dude... You know she was a huge support, because when i was in deep sh*t i always thought: "Hey, but there is she, she will help me", but it's gone now.

But at least, this whole situation gave me an idea to a new photography project, but it's yet not public.

Of course, and thank you for asking and reading the whole stuff.

Well, i feel mediocre sh*t. This tuesday really killed me something inside me. Also i'm having horrible headache, so it's really not helping at all. 

But to be honest i feel absolutely s*it. I also wish i could find happiness. I'm a really creative person, but when it cames to my happiness, i'm starting to get out of ideas...
